name: Size Experiments at Morinomma Tech
source:
As a worker at Morinomma Tech with some experiment happy uppers, it's on you to assist them with their experiments, and even test them out. First you need to find them around the building. Three bottles to find and use on you or your other scientists leading the experiments, maybe something else to do when you find all three.

[From [url=https://kogochew.itch.io/size-experiments-at-mori]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
作为Morinomma Tech的一名员工，你有一些实验快乐的鞋面，你有责任协助他们进行实验，甚至测试它们。首先你需要在建筑物周围找到它们。找到三个瓶子，并用在你或你的其他领导实验的科学家身上，当你找到这三个瓶子时，也许还可以做点别的事情。

[来自[url=https://kogochew.itch.io/size-experiments-at-mori]itch.io[/url]]
